title: Customer Success Engineer (SaaS)
description:
**About BotSpace**

BotSpace builds AI agents for e-commerce brands. They help brands sell more and handle customer support across their website, WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels. We work with fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands and are building an AI-native platform for sales, support and customer engagement.

**The role**

This is a customer role for an engineer. You'll own a group of BotSpace customers from the day they sign: get them live, learn how their business runs, find what stops them getting value from BotSpace and solve it. Sometimes that's configuration. Sometimes it's a script or an integration with the rest of their stack. Sometimes it's a bug you've narrowed down so well that our engineers can fix it the same day.

Elsewhere this job is called a forward-deployed engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager. It isn't a pure development role: most of your week is spent with customers, and the code you write is in service of them.

**What you'll do**

* Onboard new brands: WhatsApp Business API setup, Meta verification and message templates, Shopify and other integrations, their first automations and their AI agent
* Own the relationship with your accounts on calls, WhatsApp and email, and review with them regularly what's working and what isn't
* Debug customer issues end to end: read the logs, check API responses and webhooks, reproduce the problem, then fix it or give engineering a bug report they can act on
* Build what a customer needs on top of the product: API and webhook integrations, small scripts, data imports, custom flows
* Notice early when an account is at risk, and when one is ready to do more with us
* Bring patterns back to the product team: repeat issues, missing features, rough edges in onboarding
* Write the docs and playbooks that help the next customer go live faster

**What we're looking for**

* A software engineer by training: B.E. or B.Tech in computer science or IT, MCA, or real hands-on coding experience
* 2 or more years in a customer-facing technical role at a software company: technical support, application support, implementation, solutions or customer success engineering
* You can read code and write some: JavaScript or Python scripts, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL or MongoDB queries
* You debug methodically and can explain what broke to a non-technical founder in plain words
* Clear spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with founders and operations teams
* You follow through. When a customer is waiting on something, they hear from you before they have to ask

**A major plus**

* Hands-on time with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager or a messaging platform such as Gupshup, Twilio, Wati or Interakt
* Shopify: the admin, apps, webhooks and how D2C brands run their stores
* Helpdesk and CRM tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or HubSpot
* You've set up or tuned an LLM-based product: prompts, knowledge bases, AI agents
* A stint as a developer before you moved into support or implementation

**How success is measured**

* New customers go live quickly and actually use what they bought
* The accounts you own renew and grow
* Problems get fixed at the root, so the same issue doesn't come back
* Engineering can act on your bug reports without a follow-up call

**Why join BotSpace**

You'll sit between our customers and our engineering team and work closely with the founders. You'll see how hundreds of brands use the product day to day, and what you learn goes straight into what we build next.

If you're an engineer who likes solving real problems for real customers more than closing tickets, we'd love to hear from you.

**How to apply**

Apply on our careers site: https://careers.bot.space/customer-success-engineer/apply?src=naukri

It takes about five minutes: a short form with your LinkedIn profile and a few questions. We read every application and reply within a week.

description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Mandatory (Gender) - Only Female candidates are considered.
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your mission at IntegriChain:**
Gross-to-Net is the gap between a drug’s list price and the net revenue a manufacturer realizes after rebates, chargebacks, discounts, and fees. Grss-to-Net is central to how pharmaceutical companies forecast, report, and plan.
  
  
As a GTN Analyst II, you will support multiple external clients by reconciling transactional data, validating pricing calculations, explaining variances, and producing the reports they rely on to meet contractual deadlines. You will work across our GTN systems and Excel, partner with colleagues in Pune and remote teams in the U.S. and build expertise in pharmaceutical revenue management.
  
  
**Working hours:**
This is a hybrid role based in Pune. Because you will work closely with U.S.-based clients and managers, the role requires some overlap with U.S. Eastern working hours
  
  
**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Data and reconciliation

+ Gather client transactional data, reconcile it to the general ledger, and load it into the source system.
+ Identify and resolve errors in the GTN system according to defined business rules, applying corrections as needed.
+ Monitor and review system output for consistency, accuracy, and formatting.

* Reporting and delivery

+ Produce client deliverables and reports from system results and explain the variances behind them.
+ Meet contractual SLAs by planning and prioritizing your workload around fixed deadlines.
+ Escalate issues promptly when they fall outside defined business rules or put a deadline at risk.

* Process and collaboration

+ Keep process documentation and work instructions current and aligned with RACI standards.
+ Build strong working relationships with internal colleagues and remote team members across multiple locations.

**Where You’ll Grow:**

* As you build confidence in the core role, you will cross-train in adjacent areas of Net Revenue and Compliance, as appliable:
* Government Pricing (GP): transactional and master data, GL reconciliations, and data extraction across client, internal, and external systems, fundamentals including Class of Trade (COT), PHS 340B validation, and monthly pricing calculations.
* State Price Transparency Reporting (SPTR): reporting requirements and the U.S. state regulations behind them: portfolio setup, reporting activities, and preparation of client deliverables.

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Information Management, or another business discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, accounting, or a related field.
* Experience producing financial reports, with strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, and large datasets) and working knowledge of MS Office.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with large data volumes and complex financial models.
* Sharp attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in data and reporting.
* A process-oriented, organized approach to planning work across multiple client accounts.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to collaborate with cross-functional and U.S.-based teams.
* Ability to pick up new software and systems quickly.
* Initiative to support value add projects and drive process improvements

**Nice to have**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Working knowledge of Managed Care, Medicaid, GPO contracting, or Government Pricing.
* Familiarity with GTN calculations and revenue recognition in the pharmaceutical industry.

We are seeking a skilled and collaborative Oracle Functional Analyst to join our dynamic ERP Solutions team. You will serve as a key subject matter expert driving the configuration, optimization, and production support of our Oracle Financials ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of core financial business processes and best practices, coupled with hands-on technical configuration skills. You will collaborate closely with business users, developers, and project managers to streamline financial operations, enhance reporting capabilities, and support our global footprint.

Key Responsibilities

Functional Configuration & Implementation

·       Core Module Ownership: Lead and maintain the functional configuration, testing, and production support for core Oracle Financial modules: General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), and Accounts Receivable (AR).

·       Extended Module Support: Manage and support Cash Management (CE) and Fixed Assets (FA). Experience with Oracle Projects is highly preferred.

·       System Optimization: Translate complex business requirements into scalable Oracle functional designs, adhering to industry best practices.

·       Testing & Quality Assurance: Develop test scripts, execute system integration testing (SIT), and lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for system upgrades, patches, and new features.

Business Partnership & Communication

·       Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a trusted advisor to business users, confidently guiding them through core financial topics such as month-end close, journal preparation, allocations, and consolidation processes.

·       Operational Workflows: Support and optimize payables invoicing, BPM approvals, billing, receivables, lockbox processing, customer setup, and financial reporting.

·       Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively in a team environment alongside fellow business analysts, developers, and project managers to deliver cohesive solutions.

·       Training & Change Management: Empower the finance team by developing training materials and conducting hands-on training sessions on Oracle finance topics and real-world scenarios.

Production Support & Global Operations

·       Issue Resolution: Serve as the primary point of contact for production support, utilizing proven problem-solving techniques to resolve system defects efficiently.

·       Vendor Management: Manage and log service requests (SRS) directly with Oracle Support to resolve complex technical or functional product defects.

·       Global Compliance: Support multinational business operations across the US and international regions by managing Secondary Ledger setups and corporate taxation via e-Business Tax (eBTax) and Vertex.

·       Financial Reporting: Utilize Smartview and the Financial Reporting Center to design, build, and maintain robust financial reports for leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements

·       5-8 years of experience as an Oracle Functional Analyst or Consultant specializing in the Finance domain.

·       Core Oracle Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience configuring, testing, and supporting

·       Oracle GL, AP, and AR at a minimum. Strong working knowledge of CE and FA is required.

·       Global Business Acumen: Experience working within global, multi-national companies. A solid understanding of international accounting, multi-currency environments, and global tax structures (Vertex/e-Business tax) is highly desirable.

·       Reporting Tools: Proficiency with Oracle Smartview and the Financial Reporting Center.

·       Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between technical IT teams and non-technical business stakeholders.

·       Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

What We Offer

·       The opportunity to shape a brand-new role and make a tangible impact on our global finance operations.

·       A collaborative, team-oriented work environment with exposure to cross-functional projects.

·       Continuous professional growth as we expand our Oracle footprint.

·       Fully remote environment

·       Company paid Health Insurance Coverage for Employee and Family

·       Optional Health Insurance Coverage for Parents

·       Employer Paid Provident Fund Contribution

·       PTO for salaried employees

·       Company provided equipment

·       Health & Wellness incentives

·       100% Paid Parental Leave

Competencies:

·       A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position.

·       Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise.

·       Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.

·       Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience.

Remote Location: This position allows you to work from any location with a stable internet connection. You will need to provide your own suitable workspace and internet access. Sedentary work. Exerting up to 1 0 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.

**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Role: Credit Risk Technology Angular Full Stack Engineer**

**Timings:**
11:00 AM – 08:00 PM IST

We are seeking an experienced
**Angular Full Stack Engineer**
with 8-12 years of software development experience and deep expertise in
**Angular, .NET/C# and SQL Server**
enterprise application development. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining large-scale, high-performance web applications, working closely with business and technology stakeholders, and contribute to the modernization of strategic Credit Risk platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full stack applications using Angular 16+, .NET 5/.NET 8, and SQL Server
* Build responsive and reusable UI components using Angular, Kendo UI, and Prime NG
* Develop and maintain secure, high-performance REST APIs and backend services using ASP.NET Core
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and other developers to understand requirements and deliver quality solutions.
* Write efficient SQL queries, stored procedures, and optimize database performance in SQL Server.
* Ensure code quality through best practices, code reviews, and adherence to development standards.
* Participate in application design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions.
* Support deployment, release activities, and production issue resolution.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams in an agile development environment.
* Manage code using GitLab/Git and follow CI/CD best practices
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues, provide L2 support for incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong experience in full stack development with 8–12 years in software engineering.
* Proficiency in Angular 16+ including component-based architecture, routing, services, forms, RxJS, and state handling.
* Hands-on experience with Angular UI/supporting libraries such as Kendo UI for Angular and Prime NG
* Strong backend development experience using:
* .NET 5/8, ASP.NET Core Web API
* RESTful services development
* Good understanding of C#, object-oriented programming, and backend application development.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, indexing, query optimization, performance tuning
* Experience with source control tools such as Git.
* Good understanding of SDLC, code review practices, debugging, testing, and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with API integration, authentication/authorization, and secure coding practices.
* Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Exposure to Databricks and data engineering integrations.
* Understanding of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with unit testing frameworks and frontend/backend automated testing.
* Familiarity with:
* GitHub / Git / Azure DevOps
* ServiceNow
* Jira / Confluence

**Preferred:**

* Experience building Credit Risk applications and data platforms (wholesale credit risk, counterparty credit risk, risk data flows)
* Worked in Financial Services domain

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* 8 – 12 years of experience in development roles

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

description:

Our work combines LLM-powered agents, scalable backend services, and reusable UI components to deliver seamless, connected workflows across Autodesk products and data sources.

* Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java, including async programming, testing, and building scalable backend services and REST/streaming APIs.

* Strong understanding of software architecture, security, authorization, dependency resilience (retries, timeouts), observability, and production reliability.
* Experience working in large-scale or polyglot codebases and actively using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).
* Strong technical leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive architectural decisions and work autonomously.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search, embeddings, and semantic retrieval techniques.
* Experience with prompt engineering, system prompt design, and LLM evaluation techniques.
* Experience building shared UI component libraries, data access platforms, or cross-product integrations.

Lead Software Engineer

The team develops next-generation products and services that enable cardholders to securely and efficiently access and use benefits across digital channels.
  
  
Role

Strong hands-on experience with React and/or Angular
  
  
Deep experience with REST APIs, Web Services, and microservices architecture
  
  
Strong experience with Oracle/SQL, including query optimization and data validation
  
  
**Experience With Kafka Or Other Event-driven/messaging Platforms**
Strong understanding of distributed systems, design patterns, scalability, and resiliency
  
  
Experience with CI/CD, Git, code reviews, and automated deployment pipelines
  
  
Experience with Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, containers, or equivalent cloud platforms
  
  
Knowledge of API gateways, authentication/authorization, and secure service-to-service integrations
  
  
Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and production-support experience
  
  
Ability to lead technical design, architecture reviews, PoCs, and complex technical initiatives
  
  
Strong technical leadership, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills

API and UI test automation experience

Education
